name: Timberling Seeds
summary: At Lake Al'Ameth, botanist Denalan studies the growing hostility of Teldrassil's nature elementals. He seeks to harvest Timberling Seeds and test whether enriched soil can help them grow calmer. His work is one quiet effort by night elf herbalists to understand the subtle afflictions troubling the World Tree.

sections.title: Restless Nature
sections.body: Timberlings are nature elementals native to Teldrassil's boughs, closely bound to the health and vitality of the surrounding flora. They are usually peaceful reflections of the forest's balance, but their recent hostility has alarmed the local night elves, and no cause is known. Botanist Denalan hopes to learn what has stirred them rather than simply cull them.

sections.title: Seeds of a New Growth
sections.body: Denalan suspects the blemish lies deep in the ground. He hopes to sprout fresh timberlings, a gentler generation of elementals, in enriched and carefully treated loam. By harvesting seeds from wandering timberlings near Lake Al'Ameth, he aims to learn whether the land's corruption can be countered from the roots up.

faq.answer: Timberlings are small, plant-like nature elementals found on Teldrassil. They mirror the natural order and life cycle of the great tree's flora and fauna.

faq.q: Why have the timberlings become aggressive?
faq.answer: Denalan suspects a flaw or contamination in Teldrassil's soil. As elemental manifestations of the tree's ecology, timberlings reflect the growing corruption spreading through the island.
Denalan is a night elf naturalist and botanist who tends a small garden retreat on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore. He studies Teldrassil's unusual flora and soils.

faq.q: Where can timberling seeds be gathered?
faq.answer: Timberlings roam the shaded thickets, shores, and forest glades around Lake Al'Ameth in central Teldrassil.

faq.q: What does Denalan plan to do with the seeds?
faq.answer: Denalan plans to cultivate the seeds in special, purified soil mixtures he has developed. He hopes to grow docile timberlings free from the forest's agitation.

faq.q: How does this connect to Teldrassil's wider troubles?
faq.answer: The aggression of these basic nature spirits is an early sign that Teldrassil suffers from an unnatural taint. It leads researchers toward deeper investigations in Darnassus.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, timberlings are direct signs of Teldrassil's well-being. Seeing these gentle spirits turn feral is a chilling sign that their new home is unwell.
As a druid, you have a deep affinity for nature spirits. Helping Denalan study them supports elemental balance without relying only on culling them.
As an herbalist, you can appreciate Denalan's botanical experiments on the delicate relationship between plant seeds and enriched soil.
